notes: ATG11: selective-autophagy scaffold; shared across selective/bulk autophagy (not chloroplast-specific).

ATI1: ATG8-interacting plastid-associated protein; associates with plastid-derived ATI bodies in senescence/starvation. LOW-confidence chlorophagy-selective candidate; membership literature-based, not GO-confirmed for chlorophagy. Membership literature-based (no chlorophagy GO seed hit).
ATI2: ATI1 paralog; plastid-associated ATG8-interacting. LOW-confidence chlorophagy-selective candidate; literature-based. Membership literature-based (no chlorophagy GO seed hit).

CV (Chloroplast Vesiculation): UniProt Q8S8K8 'Protein CHLOROPLAST VESICULATION'; MCP GO:1904821 chloroplast disassembly, GO:0097708 intracellular vesicle, GO:0005773 vacuole, GO:0009941 chloroplast envelope, GO:0010150 leaf senescence. Stress/senescence-induced ATG-independent vacuolar route. NOTE: Ensembl/NCBI 'histone deacetylase-like' description is a misannotation (resolved via UniProt). MEDIUM confidence chloroplast-selective candidate.
PUB4: U-box E3 ligase implicated in chloroplast quality-control / damaged-chloroplast turnover. Selective-degradation candidate; LOW-MEDIUM confidence.

SP1: RING-type E3 ubiquitin ligase (UniProt Q8L7N4 'E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase SP1 / SUPPRESSOR OF PPI1 LOCUS 1'). CHLORAD pathway — ubiquitinates the TOC import apparatus for proteasomal turnover (GO:0016567 + GO:0045037 chloroplast import, MCP-confirmed). Mechanism is ubiquitin-proteasome ENVELOPE degradation, NOT ATG8 vacuolar chlorophagy. CROSS-ORGANELLE: MCP GO:0016558 confirms SP1 also acts in peroxisome matrix import/biogenesis. MEDIUM confidence as chloroplast-selective.

SP2: UniProt Q5PP51 'SUPPRESSOR OF PPI1 LOCUS 2, chloroplastic / OEP39'; Omp85-family channel (GO:0015267) exporting ubiquitinated substrates in CHLORAD retrotranslocation (GO:0031625 ubiquitin-ligase binding, GO:0030162 proteolysis, GO:0009507 chloroplast — MCP-confirmed). Selective (CHLORAD), proteasome-linked. MEDIUM confidence.
SPL2 (SP1-like 1/2): SP1 paralog RING E3 in CHLORAD. Selective (CHLORAD). LOW-MEDIUM confidence; MCP UniProt Q9SYH3 'E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase SPL2 / SP1-like protein 2'.
